title: VI-G Synthetic Stress and Empirical Operating Boundary

final_algorithm_semantics.ordinary: Historical reputation is consumed in all K truth iterations, but the ordinary q_out-derived candidate reputation is not committed.
final_algorithm_semantics.calibration: Every 20th task in the experimental profile is an authenticated calibration event; it is excluded from scoring and is the only event that advances persistent reputation.
final_algorithm_semantics.calibration_status_handling: Attack generation is completed before calibration designation is evaluated and receives neither the calibration flag nor the authenticated reference.

attack_notes.persistent: Truth-independent response corruption: numerical x->1-x; categorical cyclic shift.
attack_notes.random: Deterministic hash-derived random reports independent of truth.
attack_notes.on_off: 5 benign + 5 corrupted tasks; 10 seeds benign-first and 10 seeds attack-first.
attack_notes.excluded_fixed_target: The old fixed-target stress axis is not reused because realized attack validity/strength can depend strongly on the task truth distribution.

statistics.primary_test: exact one-sided paired sign-flip, LIR-PPTD loss < Mean/MV loss
statistics.holm_scope: family x attack across five nonzero malicious ratios

interpretation_policy: Any crossover is an empirical operating-boundary observation, not a theoretical critical malicious-worker threshold.
